title: (I) AUTOBIOGRAPHY: Mani and his Divine Twin
english_translation:
[R]
He said, "I [have not ...- ed] you, and I [have not let go of] you. I have given you another ... and have *protected you." {b.1} And even now he himself (5) accompanies me, and he himself keeps and protects me. And by his power I fight with Az and Ahrimen and teach men wisdom and knowledge and save (10) them from Az and Ahrimen.

{b.2} And I [have lived by?] these matters of the gods and the wisdom and knowledge of soul-gathering that I received from [the] (15) Twin ...

[V]
{b.3} ... by [the power of] the Twin I stood [aloft before] my own family, and the cousel of the wise seized me.
And (5) these things that the Twin had taught me I then began to tell and to teach to my father and the elders. And when they heard it they were astonished.
(10) And just like a wise man who might find the seed of a good and fruit-bearing tree in untilled soil and might *harvest (it), [ ... ], and *carry it and [sow it in?] (15) a [well- ]tilled and prepared soil ...

[R]
[ ... ] the twin who was *sent [from? that] light and good grace of the gods (= the Living Soul) [that] *Az stole. And he did not allow [ ... ] to [ ... ]. He protects the world [ ... ] liberator and saviour ...

[V]
[ ... ] and about that light and good grace of the gods that Az stole. And he [sent?] to the [land] of Babylon and to all the lands ...

[S 1]
Then I began ... the Twin in Babylon [ ... ] the land [of ?] in all places to wander [ .] thing [ ... ]

[S 2]
[ ... was together [with ... ] [ ... ] and Arwayistan (= Mesopotamia) [ ... ] that away to Rome [ ... ] and there teach [ ... ]
